items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: accompanied him for the first time there in the Liborio. Well for first time, but several times

ctx.x: That was his popular saying, “De película!” (From the movies!) I also
accompanied him for the first time there in the Liborio. Well for first time, but several times, I say for the first time in the Liborio and then at the Chateau Madrid, too. Yes.
Let's see who else appears here on this list . . . Armando Manzanero . . .
